items.headline: Gunfight between Naga armed groups kills 3–4
items.text: Three to four suspected members of rival Naga armed groups were killed in a gunfight in Noney district early Wednesday, officials and residents say; reports differ on the toll and several were injured.

photo.alt: A green river valley between forested hills, with a small town of tin roofs along the river.
photo.caption: Noney town in its river valley, Manipur, in 2010.

items.headline: Supreme Court frees man held weeks after bail
items.text: The Supreme Court ordered Uttar Pradesh to free a man still jailed weeks after it granted him bail on 28 September, and to show why he should not be compensated; no state explanation was reported.

photo.alt: A domed red and cream building with an Indian flag, behind trees and a black statue on a pedestal.
photo.caption: The Supreme Court of India in New Delhi.

items.place: Sree Sankaracharya University of Sanskrit, Kalady, Kerala
items.headline: Kerala court bars suspended protesting students from exams
items.text: Kerala's High Court barred 16 students suspended after an August campus protest from exams, citing attendance rules and saying dharnas have "no place" on campuses; the students have moved the Supreme Court.

photo.alt: A long white building with red tiled roofs and small towers behind palm trees and a green field.
photo.caption: The Sree Sankaracharya University of Sanskrit at Kalady, Kerala, in 2008.

items.headline: Thousands block highway against Karnataka river-link plan
items.text: More than 10,000 people blocked the Hubballi–Karwar highway in Yellapur on Tuesday against the Bedthi–Aghanashini river-linking plan, ETV Bharat reported; no state or central government response was reported.

photo.alt: A shallow river flowing over dark rocks between green bushes, with forested hills behind.
photo.caption: The Aghanashini river seen from Santhgal, Uttara Kannada, in 2014.

items.headline: Karnataka court quashes case over rally slogan
items.text: Karnataka's High Court quashed a case against a man who shouted a pro-Pakistan slogan at a 2022 Mandya rally, accepting it was a slip of the tongue; prosecutors had alleged intent to cause unrest.

photo.alt: A large red colonnaded building with a triangular pediment behind a fence and gardens.
photo.caption: The High Court of Karnataka in Bengaluru (Attara Kacheri), in 2019.

items.place: West and South Kordofan and Blue Nile, Sudan
items.headline: Drone strikes kill at least 14 civilians
items.text: Drone strikes killed at least 14 civilians in West and South Kordofan and Blue Nile on Monday and Tuesday, residents told Radio Dabanga; a Blue Nile group blames the RSF, which had no reported response.

photo.alt: Rooftops and a tall beige building seen through the branches of a leafy tree under a hazy sky.
photo.caption: A street view in Damazin, capital of Blue Nile state, in 2019. Drone strikes hit several neighbourhoods on Tuesday.

items.headline: Joshua Wong jailed for 10 more years
items.text: A Hong Kong court sentenced democracy activist Joshua Wong, 30, to 10 years for conspiring to collude with foreign forces; authorities say the security law keeps stability, while HRW calls the charges baseless.

photo.alt: A white concrete court building signed 'The High Court' at the foot of tall glass towers, beside a road.
photo.caption: The High Court Building in Admiralty, Hong Kong, in April 2026.

items.headline: Gunfire hits tents at Rafah displacement site
items.text: Gunfire hit tents at a displacement site in northern Rafah on Tuesday, reportedly injuring people and forcing an aid group to leave, OCHA said; no Israeli military comment was reported.

photo.alt: Men walk past a heavily damaged mosque with a tall minaret and a water tank, between shattered buildings under a blue sky.
photo.caption: A damaged mosque near Tel al-Sultan camp, Rafah, in March 2025.
photo.credit: Ashraf Amra / UNRWA, via Wikimedia Commons

items.place: Ouahigouya district, Yatenga province, Burkina Faso
items.headline: Armed group killed 27 civilians, HRW finds
items.text: The Al-Qaeda-linked group JNIM killed at least 27 civilians in two September attacks in Yatenga province, HRW said on Wednesday; JNIM told HRW the victims were members of government-allied militias.

photo.alt: A wide red dirt street lined with trees and market stalls, with people walking and a man on a motorbike.
photo.caption: A market street in Ouahigouya, Burkina Faso, in 2011.

items.headline: Police tear-gas striking garment workers
items.text: Police fired tear gas and stun grenades at garment workers demanding higher pay on Wednesday, with dozens injured in Fatullah, media report; officials say a new wage board's pay scale starts in January.

photo.alt: A brick embankment road beside wide floodwater under a cloudy sky, with a food cart and a few people.
photo.caption: An embankment road in Ashulia, near Dhaka, in 2007. About 100 factories there remain shut.

focus.title: Sudan's long war
focus.dek: Since April 2023 Sudan's war has killed at least 59,000 people by one count. Drone strikes killed at least 14 civilians in Kordofan and Blue Nile on 2–3 November.
focus.alt: Women in long robes and headscarves walk across sandy ground carrying bags and boxes of supplies on their heads and in their arms, with more people behind them.
